justification: `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/NamingStrategy.java` is a 559-line class file that bundles the interface, an abstract base, three concrete naming strategies (`Suffixing`, `SuffixingRandom`, `PrefixingRandom`), and a nested `BaseNameResolver` hierarchy with multiple resolver implementations plus deprecated compatibility wrappers and many overloaded constructors. `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/NamingStrategyTest.java` exercises these pieces as separate behaviors (suffixing, random suffixing, prefixing, resolver variants, caller suffix), which is evidence of several separable responsibilities packed into one unit.
